error.owner_text: There is no running instance of the task.
error.diagnosis: The one-shot precheck wrote its success receipt before IRunningTask.Refresh was polled; the wrapper did not handle that completed-instance result.

recovery: Prepare a separately reviewed continuation from the verified protected checkpoint; do not delete the task, receipt or copied source, and do not blindly rerun the fresh-only wrapper.
